questions.question: In a letter to believers in Rome, the writer said love must be sincere. What did he say they should do about evil and good?

answers.text: Detest evil and cling to good

questions.question: What did the writer of this letter to believers tell them to do for the people who persecute them?
In a letter to believers, the writer said not to avenge themselves. What did he say they should leave room for instead?
The writer of this letter told believers to live at peace with everyone. What limit did he put on it?

answers.text: As far as it depends on them
As long as others apologize first
As long as it feels fair to them
